page.overview:
Who is Ba'Gamnan?

Ba'Gamnan is a temporary group leader in Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings, who also appears as a recurring boss. His equipment cannot be changed, and he has no Quickening. Ba'Gamnan acts similar to the Dark Knight, able to inflict status ailments as well as sacrifice his HP to inflict damage to an enemy. He can also learn, after a lot of training, magicks like Bad Breath and Souleater.

Ba'Gamnan is as a temporarily playable character from the end of "Mission 09: Reinforcements" to when the party arrives at the Muruc Cahuac Skysea in Chapter 4.

While Ba'Gamnan is a playable character, he learns various unique skills.
